Claim 13 (Currently amended): A flexible respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the tube arrangement comprising: a flexible tube; a heater to heat the gas as it is delivered through the tube; a first connector provided to one end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a breathing mask; and a second connector provided to the other end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a CPAP device, said second connector including a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to said heater, wherein said contact elements are adapted to be engaged with a power supply provided on the CPAP device for supplying power to said heater, and wherein the flexible tube is configured to maintain a consistent gas flow and temperature.

Claim 14 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising an insulating sheathing body that encases at least a portion of the flexible tube.

Claim 15 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the insulating sheathing body is removably attachable to the flexible tube and is structured to enhance thermal insulation.

Claim 16 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the heater is integrated into the sheathing body and is designed to uniformly distribute heat along the length of the tube.

Claim 17 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein said sheathing body includes a multi-layered design that enhances thermal efficiency.

Claim 18 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the tube is a heatable respiratory gas tube that is flexible and resistant to kinking.

Claim 19 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the heater is integrated into the tube and is capable of rapid heating of the respiratory gas.

Claim 20 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein said second connector further includes a pressure measuring tube connection that allows for monitoring of gas pressure.

Claim 21 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising a respiratory gas humidifier that is integrated into the tube arrangement.

Claim 22 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is adapted to be connected to a water source via a humidification line that is detachable.

Claim 23 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is in the form of a flexible tube piece disposed between the breathing mask and the respiratory gas tube, allowing for easy replacement.

Claim 24 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the flexible tube is made from a spirally reinforced plastic material that enhances durability and flexibility.

Claim 25 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the heater is an electrical resistance heater that operates at a specified voltage.

Claim 26 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device, and wherein the contact elements are designed to minimize electrical resistance.

Claim 27 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each contact surface is provided within the second portion and is structured to ensure reliable electrical connection.

Claim 28 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion, allowing for a compact design.
